908134 ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT . THIS ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AND EASEMENT AGREEMENT (this “Agreement"), made as of the 27" day of April, 2016, by and between NICHOLAS TRIBUZIO and ELIZABETH A. FRANKS, individuals, having an address at 170 Union Street, Brooklyn, New York 11231 ("Owner"), and PRESIDENT STREET DEVELOPMENT PARTNERS LLC, a New York limited liability company, having an address at c/o Avery Hall Investments, 175 Varick Street, New York, New York 10014 ("Developer") (Owner and Developer are sometimes hereinafter collectively referred to as the “Parties"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Owner is the owner in fee of certain land, with a building and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Brooklyn, County of Kings, City and State of New York, known as Lot 13 in Block 343 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, and as and by the street address 170 Union Street, Brooklyn, New York 11231, and more particularly described on Exhibit “A" annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the “Owner Land"; the building located thereon or which may be located thereon in the future is herein referred to as the "Qwner Building"; and the Owner Land and the Owner Building are herein collectively referred to as the“OwnerParcel"); WHEREAS, Developer is the owner in fee of certain land, with any buildings or improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Brooklyn, County of Kings, City and State of New York, known as Lots 40,42,43,44,45,47,48,49,and 147 in Block 343 0n the Tax Map of the City of New York, and as and by the street addresses 141, 143, 145, 145A, 147, and 151 President Street, Brooklyn, New York 11231, and more particularly described on Exhibit “B" : annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land being herein called the *“Developer Land"); WHEREAS, Developer intends to construct a new building or enlarge an existing building on all or a portion of the Developer Land which may be enlarged as provided for herein (the new building and improvements, together with any additions thereto or future alterations thereto or replacements thereof not prohibited by the provisions of this Agreement, are herein collectively referred to as the “Developer Building," and the Developer Land and the Developer Building are herein collectively referred to as the *"Developer Parcel");
